summary.headline: 7650-7660 is the dominant conditional floor; 7675 is the main pivot
key_points: Near-spot and OTM call flow is almost balanced after removing the deep-ITM 7570C distortion.
Put selling is persistent and concentrated at 7650-7660, making this the main downside risk-acceptance zone.
A 7700C buy / 7700P sell package is synthetic-long-like and makes 7700 the upper decision level.
Acceptance below 7650 would invalidate the most stable supportive feature of the baseline and expose 7625-7620.
summary.daily_note: Baseline for the 2026-08-26 0DTE session: 7650-7660 conditional floor, 7675 pivot, 7700 upper decision. Raw call selling is dominated by deep-ITM complex flow and should not be read as a clean bearish signal.

leave_one_out.comment: The largest single 7570C sale does not change the raw call sign. However, excluding the full 7570C deep-ITM cluster changes net calls from -$7.88M to approximately +$0.72M, so the apparent call-selling bias is not robust.

levels.label: MAIN CONDITIONAL FLOOR / PUT RISK ACCEPTANCE
levels.interpretation: The strongest persistent feature of the baseline is concentrated put selling across 7650-7660. The zone is supportive while held, but acceptance below 7650 can turn the same short-downside inventory into an instability source.

notes: Put selling remains strongly negative even after excluding the largest put print.

levels.label: MAIN PIVOT / CENTRAL OPTIONALITY
levels.interpretation: 7675 is the closest high-activity strike to spot and carries two-sided optionality. It is better treated as the central decision pivot than as a directional support or resistance level.

notes: Both call and put premium are net bought at 7675.

levels.label: UPPER DECISION / SYNTHETIC-LONG-LIKE INVENTORY
levels.interpretation: A matched 200x 7700C buy and 200x 7700P sale is synthetic-long-like. This makes 7700 an upper decision level, but the broader OTM call tape does not yet show clean upside chase.

notes: The matched legs printed at the same timestamp with 200 contracts each.

levels.label: SECONDARY COMPLEX INVENTORY / DOWNSIDE TRANSITION
levels.interpretation: Repeated 7620C buy / 7625C sell pairings look like call-debit-spread activity. Because both strikes are deep ITM relative to spot, the gross premium is not a clean directional signal. The zone becomes more relevant after a 7650 breakdown.

notes: Repeated same-timestamp and same-size pairings support a spread interpretation.

levels.label: DEEP-ITM CALL COMPLEX / AGGREGATE DISTORTION
levels.interpretation: 7570C is the largest premium strike but is deep ITM and heavily marked Spread/Block. Removing the full cluster flips aggregate call flow from strongly negative to slightly positive, so it should not be rendered as a normal bearish call wall.

notes: 7570C represents about 18.9% of total visible gross premium.
Several linked subsets pair 7570C sales with 7650C buys.

structures.interpretation: A concentrated same-timestamp put-sale package reinforces 7650-7655 as downside risk acceptance. Because every row is marked Spread and there is no complex-order ID, the package cannot be proven as naked opening short puts.
Matched 200x call-buy and put-sale legs at the same strike and timestamp are synthetic-long-like. This supports 7700 as an upper decision level, not proof of breakout demand.
Multiple same-timestamp, same-size 7620C buy / 7625C sell pairs resemble repeated call debit spreads. Deep-ITM moneyness reduces the usefulness of gross premium as a directional conviction measure.

The 7570C premium cluster is deep ITM, mostly Spread/Block, and partially linked with 7650C legs. It is treated as complex inventory and an aggregate-distortion source rather than a clean call-supply wall.

monetization_zones.description: Persistent put selling favors settlement above 7650-7660 while the range holds.
monetization_zones.caveat: Acceptance below 7650 can reverse the economic character of the same short-downside inventory. Opening/closing is unknown.

scenarios.name: Range / decay around 7675

triggers.description: Keep the concentrated put-sale floor intact
No clean upside acceptance through the synthetic decision level

invalidations: Accepted move above 7700 with fresh call buying
Accepted move below 7650 with failed reclaim
scenarios.interpretation: While SPX remains between 7650 and 7700, the baseline favors chop/decay and mean reversion around the 7675 pivot.

scenarios.name: Upside realization

triggers.description: Hold above the upper decision level rather than briefly trade through it
Fresh OTM call demand confirms that the move is more than synthetic inventory

scenarios.interpretation: Acceptance above 7700 plus new call buying would convert the map from supportive range to upside realization toward 7725 and 7740.

scenarios.name: Conditional-floor failure

triggers.description: Failure to regain 7650 confirms that the prior supportive floor is no longer working
Fresh downside protection replacing put selling strengthens the breakdown

invalidations: Quick reclaim of 7650 with renewed put selling
scenarios.interpretation: Below 7650 the most stable supportive feature of the baseline fails. The next transition is 7625-7620, followed by 7600 if downside flow expands.

caveats: 276 of 349 rows are marked Spread, but complex_order_id is absent for all rows.
Deep-ITM premium materially distorts raw call aggregates, especially the 7570C cluster.
The source timestamp field is labeled America/New_York but the clock range appears inconsistent with normal RTH; event ordering is used, but absolute clock interpretation is treated cautiously.
Visible tape is filtered to $50k+ and is not the full market position.
